doc.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Schillinger, Slonimsky and Berklee: music and mathematics
summary: Baker asks about Schillinger House and Berklee. Jones mentions Charlie Mariano, says Coltrane carried Slonimsky's thesaurus of scales, and that Giant Steps drew on it.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: That’s what I was saying again though. When I went back and started preparing to do this, I look and almost every place your footprint or fingerprint was there, like with that. Tell me a little bit about the Schillinger House and Berklee, when you were over there with Herb Pomeroy and those guys.

Charlie Mariano. I didn’t know what they were talking about at first, but later on, everybody from [Nicholas] Slonimsky – [John] Coltrane used to carry that book around, thesaurus, the scales.
